name: Dig a Brainrot
desc:
⛏️ Welcome to Dig to Save Brainrot ⛏️

How to play:
💰 Dig through the ground and discover rare Brainrots!
⚒️ Upgrade your pickaxes to mine faster and unlock new zones.
🎯 Rescue Brainrots and earn trophies to access the next worlds.
🥚 Collect and hatch eggs to get special Brainrots with powerful boosts.
🌍 Explore new worlds, each with unique materials and secrets.

💻 Available on PC, Mobile, and Tablet
